confidence_notes: Low confidence overall. Web searches gave only travel-guide and aggregator ranges for Munnar restaurant meals (roughly INR 100-300 per person at local eateries, INR 300-600 per person at mid-range restaurants). Those ranges anchor the two meal figures. I found no Munnar-specific cappuccino, bar beer, cocktail or wine-by-the-glass prices. The only related results were Kerala retail beer price lists, a Kochi cost-of-living proxy (basic meal about INR 150, coffee INR 50-100), and bar menus from other Indian cities. So coffee, beer, cocktail and wine are estimates from general knowledge of Kerala's high alcohol taxes and tourist-bar pricing. Cocktail is set at about 1.8x beer and wine glass at about 1.6x beer. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no listings or booking pages inspected, tilted modestly toward July monsoon low-season rates. The private hostel room is set above the basic-lodge anchor because branded hostels usually charge more than local lodges. INR amounts were converted at an assumed INR 95 per USD, which was not searched. The FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate pages as shown in search results (0.6720 USD per AUD, 4pm on 18 November 2026).
comparable_city_reasoning: Kochi and Kerala were the baseline: Kochi is the nearest large city, about 130 km away, and Kerala's alcohol pricing is similar. I added a modest hill-station tourist premium for restaurants and resort-bar drinks. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Indian hill-station tourism markets, including Munnar's monsoon low season, not any specific listing.
